title: 项目：文件分析工具
subtitle: 综合运用文件操作、字符串处理、数据结构

blocks.text: 创建一个文件分析工具，读取文本文件并统计行数、单词数、字符数等信息。

blocks.code:
def analyze_file(filename):
    with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    lines = content.split('\n')
    words = content.split()
    
    stats = {
        '行数': len(lines),
        '单词数': len(words),
        '字符数': len(content),
        '字符数(无空格)': len(content.replace(' ', ''))
    }
    
    return stats

stats = analyze_file('sample.txt')
for key, value in stats.items():
    print(f'{key}: {value}')

blocks.text:
行数: 10
单词数: 50
字符数: 300
字符数(无空格): 250

blocks.question: 为什么使用with open()而不是普通open()？
blocks.explain: with语句确保文件使用后自动关闭，即使发生异常

blocks.title: 练习：统计特定单词
blocks.code:
def count_word(filename, target):
    with open(filename, 'r') as f:
        words = f.read().split()
    count = words.count(target)
    return count

count = count_word('article.txt', 'Python')
print(f'Python出现{count}次')
blocks.hint: 使用split()分割单词，count()统计次数
